title: Mission: The Elephant
subtitle: Meet a giant with a remarkable trunk.
summary: Find the elephant’s body parts, explore its movements, and guide it through a day of walking, eating, and resting.
activityInstruction: Choose Walk, Eat, then Rest. Watch each movement finish before choosing the next action.
codingInstruction: Use the blue Bricks4Kidz 360 servo 2 angle blocks. Build toward the supplied logo-touch program: repeat 10, angle 180, pause 500 ms, angle 0. Use Previous/Next and Full program.
exploreInstruction: Choose a motion, then play or pause it. Watch the legs and trunk. Turn the elephant to compare both sides.

storyQuestions.success: The children went to the forest.
They heard a loud BOOM! BOOM!

storyQuestions.success: They found footprints on the ground.

storyQuestions.prompt: Were the footprints big or small?

storyQuestions.success: Big ears appeared behind the trees.

storyQuestions.prompt: What did the ears look like?

storyQuestions.success: A long nose picked up the branch.

storyQuestions.prompt: What body part can an elephant wave?
What are we going to build?
storyQuestions.success: We are going to build an elephant.

storyQuestions.success: We make our model move by touching it.

parts.label: Trunk
parts.fact: The long trunk helps an elephant smell and pick up food.
parts.help: Find the long nose at the front.

parts.label: Ears
parts.fact: The large ears help an elephant hear and release body heat.
parts.help: Look beside the head. Turn the model to see the other ear.

parts.label: Legs
parts.fact: Four strong legs support the body and move the elephant along.
parts.help: Find a leg under the body.

parts.label: Body
parts.fact: The large body joins the head, legs, and tail.
parts.help: Find the broad middle of the elephant.

parts.label: Tail
parts.fact: The tail can swish to help brush away insects.
parts.help: Turn the elephant to find the thin tail at the back.
